map.按三类原因排查：资源不足（describe 里显示 Insufficient c: Check three groups of causes: insufficient resources (describe shows Insufficient cpu/memory, so scale up or lower requests), unmet scheduling constraints (nodeSelector, affinity or taint tolerations not matching), and an unbound PVC (storage class or capacity issues). Events usually state the reason directly, so look there first.
